title: The Rise and Fall of the Golden Globes

sentences.en: Hi, I'm Andrew Ross-Sorkin.
sentences.zh: 嗨，我是安德鲁·罗斯·索尔金。

sentences.en: I cover business and policy for Dealbook, a daily newsletter at the
sentences.zh: 我负责《纽约时报》每日简报 Dealbook 的商业与政策报道。

sentences.en: New York Times.
sentences.zh: 《纽约时报》。

sentences.en: On November 18th, I'm going to be interviewing some of the most consequential leaders in business, politics, and culture, including J.D.
sentences.zh: 11月18日，我将在纽约市的 Dealbook 峰会现场，采访商业、政治和文化领域最具影响力的几位领袖，包括 J.D.

sentences.en: Vance, Elon Musk, Christine
sentences.zh: 万斯、埃隆·马斯克、克里斯蒂娜

sentences.en: Lagarde, Zylran Mondani, and many others, live on stage at the Dealbook Summit in New York City.
sentences.zh: 拉加德、齐尔兰·蒙达尼以及许多其他人。

sentences.en: You can watch some of these unguarded, unfiltered conversations as they happen.
sentences.zh: 你可以实时观看其中一些毫无防备、未经过滤的对话。

sentences.en: We're going to be live streaming select interviews for anyone to watch free at nytimes.com on
sentences.zh: 我们将于11月18日在 nytimes.com 上直播精选采访，供所有人免费观看。

sentences.en: November 18th.
If you're not already a subscriber, you can download the New York Times app to watch and get a month of free access to all of our journalism.
sentences.zh: 如果你还不是订阅者，可以下载《纽约时报》应用程序来观看，并免费获得我们所有新闻内容一个月的访问权限。

sentences.en: I hope you'll tune in.
sentences.zh: 我希望你能收看。

sentences.en: You won't want to miss it.
sentences.zh: 你一定不想错过。

sentences.en: From New York Times, I'm Michael Barbaro.
sentences.zh: 我是来自《纽约时报》的迈克尔·巴巴罗。

sentences.en: This is a daily.
sentences.zh: 这是《每日新闻》。

sentences.en: Today.
sentences.zh: 今天是。

sentences.en: For the past eight decades, the Golden Globes and the organization that awards them has played an outsized role in
sentences.zh: 在过去的八十年里，金球奖及其颁奖组织在

sentences.en: Hollywood and what kinds of stories it tells.
sentences.zh: 好莱坞及它所讲述的故事中扮演了超乎寻常的角色。

sentences.en: Until now, I spoke with my colleague Kyle Buchanan about the unlikely rise and abrupt fall of the Golden Globes.
sentences.zh: 直到现在，我与同事凯尔·布坎南聊了聊金球奖不可思议的崛起与突然的陨落。

sentences.en: It's Monday, January 10th.
sentences.zh: 今天是1月10日，星期一。

sentences.en: Kyle, describe last night's Golden Globes ceremony.
sentences.zh: 凯尔，描述一下昨晚的金球奖颁奖典礼。

sentences.en: Well, Michael, it was the saddest award show you ever did see or didn't see in this case because it wasn't broadcast on NBC like it usually is.
sentences.zh: 嗯，迈克尔，这是你见过的最惨淡的颁奖典礼，或者说在这情况下你根本没看到，因为它不像平时那样在 NBC 播出。

sentences.en: This year, instead of having all the big celebrities and getting the big ratings and throwing this fun show that everybody's talking about, it was live tweeted.
sentences.zh: 今年，没有汇聚所有大咖明星、没有拿到高收视率、也没有举办人人都津津乐道的好玩节目，而是进行了实况推特直播。

sentences.en: It was live tweeted from a room in the Beverly Hilton.
sentences.zh: 它是在比佛利希尔顿酒店的一个房间里进行实况推特直播的。

sentences.en: The only people who were there were the people who voted, the small group of people who vote on the Golden Globes.
sentences.zh: 唯一在场的人就是投票的人，也就是一小群对金球奖进行投票的人。

sentences.en: No stars, no broadcasts, no nothing.
sentences.zh: 没有明星，没有转播，什么都没有。

sentences.en: And this is kind of a crazy humbling for what used to be one of the biggest award shows on television, something that millions of people would watch.
sentences.zh: 对于曾经作为电视上最大、数百万人观看的颁奖典礼之一来说，这真是一种疯狂而又卑微的跌落。

sentences.en: The third biggest award show behind the Grammys and the Oscars, you know, that got the biggest names in Hollywood year after year to attend.
sentences.zh: 它是仅次于格莱美奖和奥斯卡奖的第三大颁奖典礼，你知道，它年复一年地吸引着好莱坞最大牌的明星出席。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And here I'm going to confess, I am a loyal Golden Globes watcher.
sentences.zh: 在这里我坦白一下，我是金球奖的忠实观众。

sentences.en: I don't miss it.
sentences.zh: 我每届必看。

sentences.en: I've watched it since I was, I think, 13 or 14.
sentences.zh: 我想我从13、14岁就开始看了。

sentences.en: And so when NBC took it off the air, effectively canceling the show for the audience, it was a surprise.
sentences.zh: 所以当 NBC 停播它、等于对观众取消了这个节目时，这让人感到意外。

sentences.en: So tell us the story of what led to this moment.
sentences.zh: 那么给我们讲讲导致这一时刻的故事吧。

sentences.en: Yeah, I think the important thing to note here, Michael, is that the show is being canceled mostly because of the group behind the show.
sentences.zh: 好的，我认为这里需要注意的重要一点是，迈克尔，这个节目被取消主要是因为节目背后的那个群体。

sentences.en: The very small, mysterious group called the Hollywood
sentences.zh: 那个非常小型、神秘的组织，叫做好莱坞

sentences.en: Foreign Press.
sentences.zh: 外国记者协会。

sentences.en: And when you want to tell the story of the Hollywood Foreign Press, you basically have to go back all the way to the golden age of Hollywood, the 1940s.
sentences.zh: 而当你想要讲述好莱坞外国记者协会的故事时，你基本上必须一直追溯到好莱坞的黄金时代，即20世纪40年代。

sentences.en: Played one, Sam, for all time's sake.
sentences.zh: 山姆，为了旧日时光，再弹奏一曲吧。

sentences.en: This is when Hollywood was becoming Hollywood.
sentences.zh: 正是在这个时候，好莱坞正在成为好莱坞。

sentences.en: Alicia, what's wrong with you?
sentences.zh: 艾莉西亚，你怎么了？

sentences.en: I'm so glad you came.
sentences.zh: 我很高兴你来了。

sentences.en: You've got Cary Grant.
sentences.zh: 你有加里·格兰特。

sentences.en: You've got Humphrey Bogart.
sentences.zh: 你有亨弗莱·鲍嘉。

sentences.en: Of all the gin joints in all the towns in all the world, she walks into mine.
sentences.zh: 世界上那么多城镇，城镇里有那么多酒馆，她却偏偏走进了我的.

sentences.en: This is when huge stars were being made.
sentences.zh: 正是在这个时候，巨星被塑造出来。

sentences.en: This is when history was being written.
sentences.zh: 正是在这个时候，历史正在被书写。

sentences.en: Mary, I know what I'm going to do tomorrow and the next day and next year and the year after that.
sentences.zh: 玛丽，我知道我明天、后天、明年以及接下来的每一年要做什么。

sentences.en: I'm shaking the dust of this crummy little town off my feet and I'm going to see the world.
sentences.zh: 我要拂去这个破烂小镇的尘土，去看看世界。

sentences.en: And these foreign journalists who came to Hollywood trying to write about it were not finding a lot of success.
sentences.zh: 这些来到好莱坞并试图对其进行报道的外国记者并没有取得多大成功。

sentences.en: I mean, if you're a nobody from some Polish newspaper, how are you going to get the biggest names in Hollywood to even pay attention to you, let alone sit for an interview?
sentences.zh: 我的意思是你如果是某个波兰报纸的无名小卒，你怎么能让好莱坞最大牌的人物甚至注意到你，更不用说坐下来接受采访了？

sentences.en: So this very small group of journalists under 100 people all banded together thinking strength in numbers and created the Hollywood Foreign Press Association.
sentences.zh: 所以这个由不到100人组成的小型记者群体抱团取暖，认为人多力量大，并创建了好莱坞外国记者协会。

sentences.en: And very quickly they found out that the even better way to get Hollywood's eye is to give out awards, to throw an award show, because that's the best way
sentences.zh: 他们很快发现，吸引好莱坞目光的更好方法是颁发奖项、举办颁奖典礼，因为这是最好的方式

sentences.en: for not just to get face time with these celebrities, not just to guarantee that they're going to show
sentences.zh: 不仅能与这些名人面对面，不仅能保证他们会出席

sentences.en: up and, you know, collect a shiny piece of golden hardware, but to grow your own influence.
sentences.zh: 并且，你知道，领走闪亮的金色奖杯，还能扩大你自己的影响力。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: Because who doesn't want an award?
sentences.zh: 因为谁不想要个奖呢？

sentences.en: Yeah, I mean, if you want to spring an award on me right now, Michael, I will accept it.
sentences.zh: 对啊，我的意思是，如果你现在想突然给我颁个奖，迈克尔，我会接受的。

sentences.en: Just don't have the orchestra play me off.
sentences.zh: 只要别让乐队把我奏乐赶下台就行。

sentences.en: Best first time guest so far.
sentences.zh: 到目前为止最佳初次嘉宾。

sentences.en: Oh, I'd like to thank my agents, my manager, God, et cetera, et cetera.
sentences.zh: 哦，我要感谢我的经纪人、我的经理、上帝，等等等等。

sentences.en: So, these foreign journalists have banded together and started giving out awards to gain stature and access.
sentences.zh: 所以，这些外国记者抱团并开始颁发奖项，以获取地位和接触渠道。

sentences.en: Does it work?
sentences.zh: 这管用吗？

sentences.en: It starts to.
sentences.zh: 开始管用了。

sentences.en: You know, at this point, the Academy Awards had been around for about 20 years.
sentences.zh: 你知道，此时奥斯卡奖已经存在大约20年了。

sentences.en: They had the big kahuna of movie awards.
sentences.zh: 它们拥有电影奖项中绝对的大佬地位。

sentences.en: And the Golden Globes very cleverly positioned themselves in January, a couple months before the Oscars were traditionally held.
sentences.zh: 而金球奖非常聪明地把自己定位在一月份，也就是传统奥斯卡颁奖典礼前几个月。

sentences.en: So the Golden Globes kind of positioned themselves as the official kickoff of awards season.
sentences.zh: 所以金球奖某种程度上把自己定位为颁奖季的官方揭幕战。

sentences.en: And if you had your eye on winning an Oscar, definitely helped to be seen winning a Golden Globe along the way.
sentences.zh: 如果你一心想赢得奥斯卡，沿途看到自己赢得金球奖绝对会有所帮助。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: So over time, with that prime position in awards season, the Golden Globes became a really big deal.
sentences.zh: 因此，随着时间的推移，凭借在颁奖季中那个黄金位置，金球奖变成了一件非常大事。

sentences.en: An evening of glamour and fun as the Hollywood foreign press plays host to the Hollywood stars.
sentences.zh: 当好莱坞外国记者协会招待好莱坞明星时，这是一个充满魅力和乐趣的夜晚。

sentences.en: Bigger and bigger stars started to show up.
sentences.zh: 越来越大牌的明星开始出现。

sentences.en: And as those big stars started to come, you have another really major thing that happens, which is that CBS picks up the award for broadcast on television.
sentences.zh: 随着这些大牌明星的到来，你迎来了另一个非常重大的事情，那就是 CBS 买下了该颁奖典礼的电视转播权。

sentences.en: Well, we're here to host the 39th annual Golden Globe Awards.
sentences.zh: 我们来到这里主持第39届年度金球奖颁奖典礼。

sentences.en: And of all the award shows, the Golden Globes is very special.
sentences.zh: 在所有的颁奖典礼中，金球奖非常特别。

sentences.en: It honors the best in both film and television.
sentences.zh: 它表彰电影和电视领域的最佳作品。

sentences.en: And with the help of the Hollywood foreign press, the world will be watching.
sentences.zh: 在好莱坞外国记者协会的帮助下，全世界都将拭目以待。

sentences.en: And CBS picking up the show really helped get this organization a lot more influence, not just inside Hollywood, but outside.
sentences.zh: 而 CBS 买下这个节目确实帮助该组织赢得了更多的影响力，不仅在好莱坞内部，还在外部。

sentences.en: People started paying attention.
sentences.zh: 人们开始关注了。

sentences.en: So suddenly the Golden Globes have reached the big leagues.
sentences.zh: 所以突然之间金球奖进入了顶级行列。

sentences.en: Yeah, but already we're getting signs of the troubles to come.
sentences.zh: 是的，但我们已经看到了麻烦即将来临的征兆。

sentences.en: What do you mean?
sentences.zh: 你是什么意思？

sentences.en: So the scandal that people point to around that time is around 1982.
sentences.zh: 人们指出的那个时期的丑闻大约是在1982年。

sentences.en: You had this actress,
sentences.zh: 当时有一位女演员，

sentences.en: Pia Zadora, who was named the new star of the year by the Golden Globes.
sentences.zh: 皮娅·扎多拉，被金球奖评为年度新星。

sentences.en: For her film Butterfly, which wasn't even out yet.
sentences.zh: 因为她的电影《蝴蝶》，当时甚至还没上映。

sentences.en: And when it did come out, the New York Times film critic Vincent Camby called Pia Zadora spectacularly inept.
sentences.zh: 而当它上映时，《纽约时报》影评人文森特·坎比称皮娅·扎多拉“荒谬绝伦地无能”。

sentences.en: She was not a star.
sentences.zh: 她根本不是什么明星。

sentences.en: It was a complete head scratcher how she'd get this sort of award until it came out that her billionaire husband had flown the HFPA to Las Vegas
sentences.zh: 大家完全摸不透她是怎么得到这种奖的，直到后来曝光她的亿万富翁丈夫用私人飞机把 HFPA 带到了拉斯维加斯

sentences.en: to his casino and wined and dined them.
sentences.zh: 去他的赌场，并宴请了他们。

sentences.en: And so, you know, created this very true appearance that the awards could be bought.
sentences.zh: 所以，你知道，这造成了一种非常真实的印象，即奖项是可以买来的。

sentences.en: It was a major stain on the Golden Globe's name.
sentences.zh: 这对金球奖的名誉是个巨大的污点。

sentences.en: And CBS actually dropped the broadcast as a result.
sentences.zh: 结果 CBS 真的取消了转播。

sentences.en: Hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯。

sentences.en: But that time in the doghouse didn't last very long.
sentences.zh: 但那段坐冷板凳的时间并没有持续太久。

sentences.en: Shortly after that, it was back on TV, and eventually NBC picked it up.
sentences.zh: 在那之后不久，它重返电视荧屏，最终 NBC 买下了它。

sentences.en: Why would NBC do that if the Golden Globes have become a source of embarrassment?
sentences.zh: 如果金球奖已经成为尴尬的来源，为什么 NBC 还要这样做？

sentences.en: Why would anyone want to be associated with this show?
sentences.zh: 为什么会有人想和这个节目扯上关系？

sentences.en: I think they decided nobody would really care.
sentences.zh: 我想他们认定根本没人会在乎。

sentences.en: That, you know, this would all blow over quickly, and they could get back to business as usual.
sentences.zh: 你知道，这一切很快就会过去，他们可以恢复以往的正常业务。

sentences.en: And it was a really lucrative business.
sentences.zh: 这是一笔非常赚钱的生意。

sentences.en: There's this whole ecosystem that had sprung up around the awards season.
sentences.zh: 围绕着颁奖季已经涌现出整个生态系统。

sentences.en: Agents, actors, studios, entertainment media, everybody saw dollar signs.
sentences.zh: 经纪人、演员、制片厂、娱乐媒体，每个人都看到了美元符号。

sentences.en: Studios wanted to tout those awards in their ads.
sentences.zh: 制片厂希望在广告中宣传这些奖项。

sentences.en: Designers wanted to get their dresses worn on the red carpet.
sentences.zh: 设计师希望自己的礼服能在红毯上被穿上。

sentences.en: Publicists wanted to get their clients seen on TV.
sentences.zh: 公关人员希望他们的客户能在电视上露面。

sentences.en: And so the networks felt like as long as this machinery was still churning, and celebrities were still showing up, the audiences would still tune in.
sentences.zh: 因此各大电视网觉得，只要这台机器还在运转，名人们还在露面，观众就会继续收看。

sentences.en: And it sounds like the networks were right.
sentences.zh: 听起来电视网是对的。

sentences.en: Yeah, basically.
sentences.zh: 是的，基本上是这样。

sentences.en: I mean, when it comes down to it, audiences just want to see a fun show.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，归根结底，观众只想看一个有趣的节目。

sentences.en: They want to turn on the TV and enjoy themselves for a little while.
sentences.zh: 他们想打开电视，好好享受一会儿。

sentences.en: And that's something that the
sentences.zh: 而这正是

sentences.en: Golden Globes always delivered in spades.
sentences.zh: 金球奖一直以来极其擅长提供的。

sentences.en: And if you step back for a second, Michael, and you just sort of think about the Golden Globes versus the Oscars, the Oscars are a very serious affair.
sentences.zh: 如果你退一步想一想，迈克尔，单纯考虑金球奖与奥斯卡的对比，奥斯卡是一件非常严肃的事情。

sentences.en: It's about crafts.
sentences.zh: 它关乎专业手艺。

sentences.en: It's about best sound, best costume design, best production design.
sentences.zh: 它关乎最佳音效、最佳服装设计、最佳美术设计。

sentences.en: The Golden Globes don't care about any of that.
sentences.zh: 金球奖才不在乎这些。

sentences.en: They care about best celebrities.
sentences.zh: 他们在乎的是最佳名人。

sentences.en: Anything that's going to get all those famous names there, that's what they care about.
sentences.zh: 任何能把所有这些大名鼎鼎的人物吸引到现场的东西，才是他们在乎的。

sentences.en: And you can kind of feel that in the difference between who votes for each award show.
sentences.zh: 你可以从投票给各个颁奖典礼的人员差异中感受到这一点。

sentences.en: You know, the Oscars are voted on by thousands of people in the industry.
sentences.zh: 你知道，奥斯卡是由业内数千人投票选出的。

sentences.en: You know, very serious people.
sentences.zh: 你知道，非常严肃的人。

sentences.en: You've got Steven Spielberg casting a vote.
sentences.zh: 你有史蒂文·斯皮尔伯格在投票。

sentences.en: You've got Martin Scorsese casting a vote.
sentences.zh: 你有马丁·斯科塞斯在投票。

sentences.en: Meryl Streep, Denzel Washington.
sentences.zh: 梅丽尔·斯特里普，丹泽尔·华盛顿。

sentences.en: You think of prestige, you think of the Oscars.
sentences.zh: 你想到声望，你就会想到奥斯卡。

sentences.en: The Hollywood Foreign Press is not like that.
sentences.zh: 好莱坞外国记者协会可不是这样。

sentences.en: First of all, it's way smaller.
sentences.zh: 首先，它的规模小得多。

sentences.en: It's less than 100 people.
sentences.zh: 它不到100人。

sentences.en: And, you know, even though some of these people are journalists, a lot of them, their journalistic bona fides are very questionable.
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道，尽管其中有些人是记者，但很多人的记者资历非常可疑。

sentences.en: And I don't want to tar every member with this brush, but I've spent time with Hollywood Foreign Press members.
sentences.zh: 我不想用这种标签一概而论所有成员，但我确实和好莱坞外国记者协会的成员相处过。

sentences.en: You know, I see them sometimes when I go to a press conference and they're usually the one, you know, enthusiastically
sentences.zh: 你知道，我有时去参加新闻发布会时会看到他们，他们通常是那个满腔热情地

sentences.en: raising their hand and asking Blake Lively something like, Blake Lively, when will you come do a movie in Brazil?
sentences.zh: 举起手并问布莱克·莱弗利诸如“布莱克·莱弗利，你什么时候来巴西拍电影？”之类问题的人。

sentences.en: And then they run up and ask her for a selfie.
sentences.zh: 然后他们会跑过去要求合影。

sentences.en: You know, these are not very serious questions.
sentences.zh: 你知道，这些并不是什么严肃的问题。

sentences.en: And because of that, these members aren't taken all that seriously.
sentences.zh: 正因如此，这些成员并没有被太当回事。

sentences.en: And maybe because it's a wackier group of people, it's a looser, more freewheeling show.
sentences.zh: 也许正是因为这是一群比较古怪的人，这是一个更松散、更无拘无束的节目。

sentences.en: And that's really fun.
sentences.zh: 那真的很有趣。

sentences.en: It also doesn't hurt that these people are sitting at banquet tables at the ceremony where the alcohol is free flowing.
sentences.zh: 另外，这些人坐在典礼的宴席桌旁，酒精畅饮不断，这也是一个助推因素。

sentences.en: And you can sense that.
sentences.zh: 你能感觉到这一点。

sentences.en: You can sense that in the acceptance speeches, which are way more loose, maybe sometimes even in the presenters who are showing up three sheets to the wind.
sentences.zh: 你能从获奖感言中感受到这一点，感言要随意得多，有时甚至能从那些喝得酩酊大醉的颁奖嘉宾身上感受到这一点。

sentences.en: And the winner is Christine Lottie.
sentences.zh: 获奖者是克里斯蒂娜·洛蒂。

sentences.en: More chaotic.
sentences.zh: 更加混乱。

sentences.en: I mean, the moments that you think of when you think of the Golden Globes are things that just would not happen on any other award show.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，当你想到金球奖时想到的那些时刻，都是在任何其他颁奖典礼上绝对不会发生的事情。

sentences.en: Christine is indisposed at the moment, I believe.
sentences.zh: 我想克里斯蒂娜现在有点脱不开身。

sentences.en: You've had Christine Lottie in the bathroom when her victory was announced and Robin Williams had to jump on stage and improvise and accept it.
sentences.zh: 当宣布克里斯蒂娜·洛蒂获奖时，她却在洗手间里，而罗宾·威廉姆斯不得不跳上舞台进行即兴表演并替她领奖。

sentences.en: I'm going to get a fool in my ear, so I hear Christine Lottie, my ear.
sentences.zh: 我的耳朵里有个傻瓜在催，我听到克里斯蒂娜·洛蒂了，在我的耳机里。

sentences.en: You had Ving Rhames winning a Golden Globe and being so overcome that he gave his trophy to his fellow nominee, Jack Lemmon.
sentences.zh: 你曾见过文·瑞姆斯赢得金球奖，激动得把自己的奖杯送给了同获提名的杰克·莱蒙。

sentences.en: I feel that being an artist is about giving, and I'd like to give this to you, Mr. Jack Lemmon.
sentences.zh: 我觉得作为一名艺术家就是在于奉献，我想把这个送给你，杰克·莱蒙先生。

sentences.en: You had Jodie Foster using the Golden Globes to kind of come out of the closet for the first time.
sentences.zh: 你还见过朱迪·福斯特利用金球奖第一次公开出柜。

sentences.en: There is no way I could ever stand here without acknowledging one of the deepest loves of my life, my ex-partner in love, but righteous soul sister in life, Sidney Bernard.
sentences.zh: 我站在这里，无论如何都必须表达对生命中最深沉的爱意之一的感谢，她曾是我在爱里的伴侣，也是我生命中正直的灵魂挚友，西德尼·伯纳德。

sentences.en: Thank you, Sid.
sentences.zh: 谢谢你，西德。

sentences.en: Thank you very much.
sentences.zh: 非常感谢。

sentences.en: You had Elizabeth Taylor on stage to announce Best Drama and appearing very drunk while doing it.
sentences.zh: 你曾请伊丽莎白·泰勒上台宣布最佳剧情片，而她当时看起来醉得很厉害。

sentences.en: What?
sentences.zh: 什么？

sentences.en: I don't open this?
sentences.zh: 我不打开这个吗？

sentences.en: I just read it from up there.
sentences.zh: 我只是从上面读出来的。

sentences.en: I know it is.
sentences.zh: 我知道是这样。

sentences.en: There was just always something that held your attention.
sentences.zh: 总有些东西能一直吸引你的注意力。

sentences.en: And all of that's really fun to watch, but it's also really good for the Hollywood ecosystem.
sentences.zh: 所有这些看点确实很有趣，而且对好莱坞生态系统也大有裨益。

sentences.en: You know, it's giving all of these stars an opportunity to make an impact, have a moment everybody's going to remember and talk about.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，这让所有这些明星有机会产生影响力，创造一个让所有人都会铭记并谈论的高光时刻。

sentences.en: But even while Hollywood is agreeing to play ball with the Golden Globes and the Hollywood foreign press, the scandals just kept piling up.
sentences.zh: 但即便好莱坞同意与金球奖及好莱坞外国记者协会合作，丑闻还是不断堆积。

sentences.en: Such as?
sentences.zh: 比如？

sentences.en: Well, one of the more famous ones happened in 1999.
sentences.zh: 嗯，其中比较著名的一起发生在1999年。

sentences.en: It involved Sharon Stone, who had, you know, a bit of Oscar buzz coming her way for her role in this Albert Brooks comedy, The Muse.
sentences.zh: 当时正值沙朗·斯通凭借在阿尔伯特·布鲁克斯的喜剧电影《缪斯》中的角色，在奥斯卡上引发了一些热议。

sentences.en: That woman, she's a muse.
sentences.zh: 那个女人，她就是个缪斯。

sentences.en: You're my new client?
sentences.zh: 你是我的新客户？

sentences.en: So I've got my own muse.
sentences.zh: 所以我有了自己的缪斯。

sentences.en: The muse.
sentences.zh: 缪斯。

sentences.en: And the film company behind the movie sent the Hollywood foreign press these $400 fancy coach watches.
sentences.zh: 这部电影背后的电影公司向好莱坞外国记者协会赠送了价值400美元的高档长途汽车手表。

sentences.en: And wouldn't you know, Sharon Stone just happened to be nominated for Best Actress in a Comedy just a few days later.
sentences.zh: 你猜怎么着，几天后沙朗·斯通就恰好获得了喜剧类最佳女主角的提名。

sentences.en: So this is a direct callback to that 1980s scandal where Pia Zadora's husband flew around all the Hollywood foreign press folks.
sentences.zh: 所以这直接呼应了20世纪80年代的那场丑闻，当时皮娅·扎多拉的丈夫带着好莱坞外国记者协会的成员到处飞。

sentences.en: And then, lo and behold, she got a nomination.
sentences.zh: 然后，果不其然，她获得了一个提名。

sentences.en: It's a lesson that they keep having to relearn and not really learning.
sentences.zh: 这是一个他们不得不一再重温却始终没有真正吸取教训的教训。

sentences.en: I mean, something pretty similar happened just a few years ago.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，就在几年前，发生了一件相当类似的事。

sentences.en: The Hollywood foreign press had to return Tom Ford fragrance gifts that were sent out right when the Globes were considering his film Nocturnal Animals.
sentences.zh: 就在金球奖考虑汤姆·福特的电影《夜行动物》时，好莱坞外国记者协会不得不退回寄出的汤姆·福特香水礼物。

sentences.en: And sure enough, that supporting actor, Golden Globe, went to one of the stars of that movie,
sentences.zh: 果然，那个最佳男配角金球奖颁给了那部电影的主演之一，

sentences.en: Aaron Taylor-Johnson.
sentences.zh: 亚伦·泰勒-约翰逊。

sentences.en: It was the only major prize he won all season.
sentences.zh: 这是他在整个颁奖季赢得的唯一一个主要奖项。

sentences.en: So here I have to confess, as a loyal longtime watcher of the show, Kyle, I didn't know any of this in real time.
sentences.zh: 所以在这里我必须承认，作为这个节目的忠实老观众，凯尔，我在当时对这一切一无所知。

sentences.en: It was all lost on me.
sentences.zh: 我完全被蒙在鼓里。

sentences.en: And further, I didn't really ever understand that actors at the show didn't really have all that much respect for the Hollywood foreign press or for the Golden Globes.
sentences.zh: 而且更进一步说，我其实从来没有意识到，参加节目的演员们对好莱坞外国记者协会或金球奖其实并没有多少敬意。

sentences.en: And so I'm seeing this all with new eyes and I guess a little bit embarrassed at how blind I was to all of this.
sentences.zh: 所以我是以全新的视角看待这一切，而且对于自己之前对此有多盲目，我猜自己感到有点尴尬。

sentences.en: Welcome to the 68th Annual Golden Globe Awards.
sentences.zh: 欢迎收看第六十八届金球奖颁奖典礼。

sentences.en: The funny thing is, the signs were kind of always there if you were looking for them.
sentences.zh: 有趣的是，如果你细心观察，这些征兆其实一直都在。

sentences.en: And now, your host for the evening, ladies and gentlemen, Ricky Gervais.
sentences.zh: 现在，有请今晚的主持人，女士们先生们，瑞奇·热维斯。

sentences.en: The show was often hosted by Ricky Gervais, this comedian.
sentences.zh: 这个节目经常由喜剧演员瑞奇·热维斯主持。

sentences.en: Hello.
sentences.zh: 大家好。

sentences.en: Who would take pot shots at Hollywood and major celebrities.
sentences.zh: 他会把好莱坞和各大名流当作抨击的目标。

sentences.en: On a serious note, just looking at all the faces here reminds me of some of the great work that's been done this year by cosmetic surgeons.
sentences.zh: 严肃点说，只要看看这里的每一张面孔，就会让我想起今年整容外科医生们所做的那些伟大工作。

sentences.en: But at the same time, he was kind of aiming a lot of his jokes at the Hollywood foreign press.
sentences.zh: 但与此同时，他的许多笑话其实也是针对好莱坞外国记者协会的。

sentences.en: One thing that can't be bought is a Golden Globe.
sentences.zh: 金球奖是无法用金钱买到的。

sentences.en: Officially.
sentences.zh: 官方层面是这样的。

sentences.en: He was saying the quiet part out loud.
sentences.zh: 他把不能明说的话大声说出来了。

sentences.en: He was saying the Golden Globe is an award that can be bought.
sentences.zh: 他在说金球奖是一个可以用钱买到的奖项。

sentences.en: And I'd like to quash this ridiculous rumor going around that the only reason the Taurus was nominated
sentences.zh: 我想平息一个流传甚广的荒谬谣言，即金球奖提名泰勒的唯一原因，

sentences.en: was so the Hollywood foreign press could hang out with Johnny Depp and Angelina Jolie.
sentences.zh: 是为了让好莱坞外国记者协会能和约翰尼·德普以及安吉丽娜·朱莉一起闲逛。

sentences.en: That is rubbish.
sentences.zh: 纯属胡扯。

sentences.en: That is not the only reason.
sentences.zh: 那不是唯一的理由。

sentences.en: They also accepted bribes.
sentences.zh: 他们还接受了贿赂。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: In retrospect, that's not very subtle.
sentences.zh: 回想起来，这并不是特别含蓄。

sentences.en: But I didn't get it.
sentences.zh: 但我当时没懂。

sentences.en: I had always chalked it up to Ricky Gervais being, Ricky Gervais, very cheeky.
sentences.zh: 我一直把这归咎于瑞奇·热维斯就是瑞奇·热维斯，非常厚脸皮。

sentences.en: Well, that's the thing about jokes, you know.
sentences.zh: 好吧，这就是笑话的妙处，你知道的。

sentences.en: They often make the truth go down easier.
sentences.zh: 它们往往能让真相更容易让人接受。

sentences.en: If you do win tonight, remember that no one cares about that award as much as you do, okay?
sentences.zh: 如果你今晚真的获奖了，请记住，没有人像你那样在乎那个奖项，好吗？

sentences.en: It's a bit of metal that some nice old confused journalists wanted to give you in person so they could meet you and have a selfie with you, okay?
sentences.zh: 这只是一块金属，一些友善而困惑的老记者想亲自送给你，这样他们就能见见你并和你自拍一张，好吗？

sentences.en: And because of that, because everyone was kind of thumbing their nose at this open secret, it didn't really ever seem like anything would change.
sentences.zh: 正因为如此，因为每个人都对这个公开的秘密不屑一顾，所以看起来似乎永远不会有什么改变。

sentences.en: Until very quickly, it did.
sentences.zh: 直到非常快地，情况发生了变化。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: The New York Times app?
sentences.zh: 《纽约时报》应用程序？

sentences.en: Unlocked?
sentences.zh: 已解锁？

sentences.en: Everyone knows you need to subscribe to the Times to access all of the reporting.
sentences.zh: 大家都知道你需要订阅《时报》才能阅读所有报道。

sentences.en: But what if you could explore the Times for a month, for free, without putting in a credit card?
sentences.zh: 但如果你可以免费体验《时报》一个月，且无需输入信用卡呢？

sentences.en: Now you can.
sentences.zh: 现在你就可以。

sentences.en: When you download the New York Times app for the first time, your first month in the app is free.
sentences.zh: 当你首次下载《纽约时报》应用程序时，你在该应用中的第一个月是免费的。

sentences.en: A month to go behind the paywall to see what Times subscribers get every single day.
sentences.zh: 有一个月的时间突破付费墙，看看《时报》订阅者每天都能获得什么。

sentences.en: If you don't already subscribe to the New York Times, download the Times app today and get free access for 30 days.
sentences.zh: 如果你还没有订阅《纽约时报》，请立即下载《时报》应用，即可获得30天的免费访问权限。

sentences.en: Kyle, given all the problems you're describing with the Golden Globes and the reality that lots of people like me watching the show didn't quite understand them
sentences.zh: 凯尔，鉴于你所描述的金球奖的所有问题，以及像我这样看节目的许多人并不完全理解这些问题这一现实，

sentences.en: and kept showing up year after year and the show is on and it seems like a happy, playful success, when do things finally start to turn?
sentences.zh: 并且年复一年地露面，节目也在播出，看起来像是一个充满欢乐和趣味的成功，事情究竟是什么时候开始出现转机的？

sentences.en: How do we get to this moment where we are right now when the Golden Globes are taken off the air?
sentences.zh: 我们是怎么走到现在这个时刻的——金球奖被停播了？

sentences.en: You know, it all started happening in 2020 and it happened faSt.
sentences.zh: 你知道，这一切在2020年开始发生，而且速度极快。

sentences.en: The Globes were coming off of one of their most successful, highly rated shows ever and then in the span of a few months, everything went to hell.
sentences.zh: 金球奖刚刚经历了其历史上最成功、收视率最高的节目之一，然后短短几个月内，一切都陷入了混乱。

sentences.en: This journalist from Norway was rejected as a member and now she is fighting back.
sentences.zh: 这位来自挪威的女记者被拒绝成为会员，现在她正在奋起反击。

sentences.en: A Norwegian journalist sued the Hollywood Foreign Press in August of that year for barring her entry.
sentences.zh: 当年8月，一名挪威记者因被拒绝入会而起诉了好莱坞外国记者协会。

sentences.en: It's all about exchanging favors for each other.
sentences.zh: 这全都是关于彼此利益交换的。

sentences.en: And accused the group of institutionalizing a culture of corruption.
sentences.zh: 并指责该组织将腐败文化制度化。

sentences.en: Sure, yeah, everyone kind of knew that, but when there's a lawsuit, people pay a little bit more attention.
sentences.zh: 当然，是的，大家心里都清楚，但一旦有诉讼，人们就会给予更多关注。

sentences.en: After that, that's when...
sentences.zh: 在那之后，那就是...

sentences.en: There are some very perplexing snubs, but I have to say the key one for me was in the best drama film and comedy film categories,
sentences.zh: 有一些令人大惑不解的冷落，但我必须说，对我而言最关键的一点是在最佳剧情片和喜剧片类别中，

sentences.en: it notably left out movies featuring black ensemble casts.
sentences.zh: 它明显漏掉了由黑人群星主演的电影。

sentences.en: The Globes failed to nominate any of the really major black-led dramas like Judas and the Black Messiah,
sentences.zh: 金球奖未能提名任何真正由黑人主演的重大剧情片，比如《犹大与黑 Messiah》、

sentences.en: Ma Rainey's Black Bottom, One Night in Miami, Spike Lee's The Five Bloods for best drama.
sentences.zh: 《蓝调天后》、《迈阿密的一夜》、《誓血五人组》入围最佳剧情片。

sentences.en: That's not the first time the Hollywood Foreign Press has shown that they have major blind spots about race.
sentences.zh: 这并不是好莱坞外国记者协会第一次暴露出他们在种族问题上有重大的盲区。

sentences.en: I mean, I even remember once at the Toronto Film Festival, I ran into the director of Moonlight, Barry Jenkins,
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，我甚至还记得有一次在多伦多电影节上，我遇到了《月光男孩》的导演巴里·詹金斯，

sentences.en: and he told me that during that week, two Hollywood Foreign Press members had mistaken him for the black director, Steve McQueen, who made 12 Years a Slave.
sentences.zh: 他告诉我，在那周里，有两位好莱坞外国记者协会的成员把他错认成了执导《为奴十二年》的黑人导演史蒂夫·麦奎因。

sentences.en: Hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯。

sentences.en: And, you know, that's the sort of thing that, unfortunately, you got with the Hollywood Foreign Press all the time.
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道的，不幸的是，这就是你经常在好莱坞外国记者协会遇到的那种事情。

sentences.en: And that sort of behavior started to come in for renewed scrutiny, in particular because the U.S.
sentences.zh: 这种行为开始受到重新审视，特别是因为美国正经历着这样一个反思种族问题的年份。

sentences.en: was going through this year of racial reckoning.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 所以正是在这种背景下，《洛杉矶时报》开始对好莱坞外国记者协会展开重大调查，

sentences.en: So it's in that context that the L.A.
sentences.zh: 他们在2021年初、也就是金球奖颁奖典礼即将举行前夕发表的内容，改变了一切。

sentences.en: Times begins this major investigation of the Hollywood Foreign Press,
sentences.zh: 他们发现了什么？

sentences.en: and what they publish in early 2021, right before the Golden Globe ceremony is about to happen, changes everything.
sentences.zh: 嗯，其中有些事情其实是隐约为人所知的，但当它们被赤裸裸地印在纸面上时，比如两面三刀的做法，

sentences.en: What do they find?
sentences.zh: 某些成员通过委员会工作获得报酬的非正统方式，大家对这些事情略有所闻，但把它们全部列出来就显得非常令人反感。

sentences.en: Well, some of it was kind of vaguely known, but to see it in print laid bare, like the double dealing,
sentences.zh: 真正引发所有人讨论的最大细节是，这个负责评选年度最重要电影的群体，竟然连一个黑人会员都没有。

sentences.en: the unorthodox way that some of these members were compensated through their committee work, people kind of knew those things, but to see it all laid out was very distasteful.
sentences.zh: 连一个挑选金球奖得主的黑人会员都没有。

sentences.en: The biggest detail that really got everybody talking was that this group of people who vote on the most important movies of the year did not have a single black member.
sentences.zh: 是的，一个都没有。

sentences.en: Not a single black member picking who wins a Golden Globe.
sentences.zh: 突然之间，许多那些非常诡异的金球奖时刻和冷落开始变得更容易理解了。

sentences.en: Yeah, nobody.
sentences.zh: 例如，像HBO的《我可以毁掉你》这样广受好评的限定剧，我非常喜欢，

sentences.en: And suddenly, a lot of those really weird Golden Globe moments and snubs started to make a lot more sense.
sentences.zh: 它由黑人女演员米凯拉·科尔创作并主演，却没有获得金球奖的任何认可，彻底遭到冷落，这让所有人感到困惑。

sentences.en: For example, a widely acclaimed limited series like HBO's I May Destroy You, which I loved,
sentences.zh: 对于很多人来说，这种冷落更让人难以接受，因为就在同一年，

sentences.en: it's created and led by the black actress Michaela Cole, got no recognition from the Globes, totally snubbed, which baffled everybody.
sentences.zh: 你有一部像《艾米丽在巴黎》这样的剧，这是一部非常空洞、具有逃避现实色彩的剧集，演员阵容大面积是白人，而金球奖却对它倾注关注并给予提名。

sentences.en: And for a lot of people, that snub was made even harder to swallow because that same year,
sentences.zh: 所以当这一内幕被揭露出来——好莱坞外国记者协会没有黑人会员，根本没有黑人参与投票评选这些奖项时，

sentences.en: you've got a show like Emily in Paris, which is this very fluffy escapist series with a largely white cast that the Globes are showering attention on and are nominating.
sentences.zh: 它提供了一个非常具体的细节，人们可以对此指指点点并团结起来。

sentences.en: So when this revelation comes out that there's no black members in the Hollywood foreign press, no black people voting on these awards at all,
sentences.zh: 然后彻底乱套了。

sentences.en: it provided this very concrete detail that people could point to and rally around.
sentences.zh: 欢迎收看2021年金球奖颁奖典礼。

sentences.en: And that's when all hell broke loose.
sentences.zh: 现在有请今晚的主持人，蒂娜·菲和艾米·波勒。

sentences.en: Welcome to the 2021 Golden Globe Awards.
sentences.zh: 所有这些细节曝光时，正值真正的金球奖颁奖典礼即将举行之际。

sentences.en: And now your hosts for the evening, Tina Fey and Amy Poehler.
sentences.zh: 听着，我们都知道颁奖典礼很愚蠢。

sentences.en: All these details came to light right as the actual Golden Globe show was about to happen.
sentences.zh: 是的，它们都是大型红毯发明的骗局。

sentences.en: Look, we all know that award shows are stupid.
sentences.zh: 主持人，艾米·波勒和蒂娜·菲。

sentences.en: Yeah, they're all a scam invented by big red carpet.
sentences.zh: 我们知道这一点。

sentences.en: The hosts, Amy Poehler and Tina Fey.
sentences.zh: 关键是，即使面对愚蠢的事情，包容性也很重要，而好莱坞外国记者协会里没有黑人会员。

sentences.en: We know that.
sentences.zh: 不得不承认这项调查的存在。

sentences.en: The point is, even with stupid things, inclusivity is important and there are no black members of the Hollywood foreign press.
sentences.zh: 来自HFPA主席阿利·萨尔和副主席海伦·霍纳。

sentences.en: Kind of had to acknowledge the investigation.
sentences.zh: 他们甚至请出了好莱坞外国记者协会的主席上台，你知道的，算是回应了每个人心中的想法。

sentences.en: From the HFPA President Ali Saar and Vice President Helen Hoona.
sentences.zh: 今晚，在我们庆祝来自全球艺术家的作品的同时，我们认识到我们自身还有工作要做。

sentences.en: They even brought out the president of the Hollywood foreign press to come on and, you know, kind of address what was on everybody's minds.
sentences.zh: 这意味着要创造一个多元化成员成为常态而非例外的环境。

sentences.en: Tonight, while we celebrate the work of artists from around the globe, we recognize we have our own work to do.
sentences.zh: 谢谢。

sentences.en: That means creating an environment where diverse membership is the norm, not the exception.
sentences.zh: 但在这之后，所有这些前所未有事情开始发生。

sentences.en: Thank you.
sentences.zh: 几乎所有的好莱坞公关公司都联合起来表示，直到HFPA解决他们的多元化问题之前，我们将切断对所有演艺人才的接触。

sentences.en: But then after that, all these really unprecedented things started to happen.
sentences.zh: 我们不会再把我们的明星送到那个节目中去了。

sentences.en: And just about every Hollywood PR firm came together and said, until the HFPA fixes their diversity problems, we're going to cut off all access to talent.
sentences.zh: 这意义重大。

sentences.en: We're not going to send our stars to that show anymore.
sentences.zh: 你在好莱坞从未见过如此统一的阵线，也从未见过如此令人叹为观止的立场反转。

sentences.en: And that's huge.
sentences.zh: 然后，在明星们表态说“不，我们不会去这个节目”之后，他们又向前迈进了一步。

sentences.en: You never see a united front like that in Hollywood or a reversal that happens so breathtakingly faSt.
sentences.zh: 你看到像斯嘉丽·约翰逊这样的人说：“老实说，我一直有点怨恨好莱坞外国记者协会。”

sentences.en: Then after the stars are saying, no, we're not going to go to this show, they go one further.
sentences.zh: 他们在新闻发布会上以及采访我时，会说出那样充满性别歧视的话。

sentences.en: You have people like Scarlett Johansson saying, well, honestly, I always kind of resented the Hollywood foreign press.
sentences.zh: 事情进一步升级，达到了这样一个地步：一向极其不问政治的汤姆·库斯宣布他将退回他的三座金球奖奖杯。

sentences.en: They would say such sexist things to me at press conferences and when they interviewed me.
sentences.zh: 各大电影公司，Netflix、华纳兄弟、亚马逊，纷纷表示要抵制这个节目。

sentences.en: And things progressed, escalated to such a point that you had Tom Cruise, who's as apolitical as they come, announcing that he would return his three Golden Globes.
sentences.zh: 所以看起来，好莱坞所有男演员和女演员对好莱坞外国记者协会多年来积压的挫败感、怨恨甚至愤怒，终于找到了一个发泄口。

sentences.en: And major studios, Netflix, Warner Brothers, Amazon, all saying that they're going to boycott this show.
sentences.zh: 然后发生了最大的事，那就是NBC宣布将不会转播该节目。

sentences.en: So it looks like years of pent-up frustration and resentment and maybe even rage at the Hollywood foreign press from all the actors and actresses in Hollywood is finding an outlet.
sentences.zh: 这是在切断金球奖的氧气。

sentences.en: And then the biggest thing happens, which is NBC announces it will not broadcast the show.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，明星们抵制是一回事，但如果连电视转播的影响力都没有了，

sentences.en: This is cutting off oxygen to the Golden Globes.
sentences.zh: 这就把他们贬回了他们的本质——一群鲜为人知的不到100人的记者群体。

sentences.en: You know, it's one thing for the stars to be boycotting it, but to not even have televised influence anymore.
sentences.zh: 没有了节目，没有了那些名流，他们什么都不是。

sentences.en: It's just reducing them to what they ultimately are, which is this group of under 100 journalists that no one actually knows.
sentences.zh: 那么好莱坞外国记者协会针对这一切说了什么、做了什么？

sentences.en: Without the show, without those celebrities, they don't have anything.
sentences.zh: 好吧，老实说，他们在采取任何行动上都一直在拖延。

sentences.en: So what has the Hollywood Foreign Press Association said and done about all of this?
sentences.zh: 你知道的，他们最初提出的大多数改革都被认为是不够的。

sentences.en: Well, to be honest with you, they've really dragged their heels on doing anything.
sentences.zh: 一些投票成员甚至因沮丧而辞职。

sentences.en: You know, a lot of the initial reforms they were proposing were deemed insufficient.
sentences.zh: 他们不得不驱逐了一位HFPA的前主席，因为他转发了一封种族主义电子邮件，而这封邮件理所当然地被泄露给了媒体。

sentences.en: Some voters even quit in frustration.
sentences.zh: 甚至连他们为了处理危机而雇用的危机公关人员也辞职了。

sentences.en: They had to expel an ex-president of the HFPA for forwarding a racist email that, of course, got leaked to the press.
sentences.zh: 所以从那以后，他们试图在伤口上贴一些创可贴，他们接纳了由21名新成员组成的新群体，其中29%的新成员为黑人身份。

sentences.en: And then even the crisis PR people that they hired to manage the situation quit.
sentences.zh: 与他们原本少得可怜的人数相比，这绝对意义重大。

sentences.en: So since then, they've tried to put some Band-Aids on the wound and they've admitted a class of 21 new members with 29% of those new members identifying as black.
sentences.zh: 但作为对比，让我告诉你学院在面对奥斯卡代表性问题时是如何回应的。

sentences.en: And that's definitely significant compared to how few they already had.
sentences.zh: 你可能还记得几年前“奥斯卡太白”的争议，连续两年只提名白人演员。

sentences.en: But just for contrast, let me tell you how the Academy has responded to that question of representation when it comes to the Oscars.
sentences.zh: 作为对这一事件的回应，投票评选奥斯卡的学院接纳了数千名新成员，你知道的，这确实平衡了许多代表性方面的问题。

sentences.en: You might recall a couple of years back there was the Oscars So White controversy of nominating only white actors two years in a row.
sentences.zh: 草稿

sentences.en: And in response to that, the Academy that votes on the Oscars admitted thousands of new members, you know, really evening out a lot of problems with representation
sentences.zh: 结束

sentences.en: that the Oscars had had for a long time.
sentences.zh: 是奥斯卡很长一段时间以来所没有的。

sentences.en: The Golden Globes have not really done that.
sentences.zh: 金球奖其实并没有真正做到这一点。

sentences.en: And the thing about admitting these, you know, scant few new members is that a lot of the members that people always had problems with are still there.
sentences.zh: 而接纳这些，你知道的，区区几个新会员的问题在于，人们一直以来诟病的很多老会员依然在那里。

sentences.en: They're still voting.
sentences.zh: 他们还在投票。

sentences.en: They're still wielding a whole lot of influence within a very small group.
sentences.zh: 他们依然在一个极小的群体内掌握着巨大的影响力。

sentences.en: Well, let's say that the Golden Globes in a way does get killed off, doesn't really come back.
sentences.zh: 好吧，假设金球奖某种程度上真的被彻底废了，再也回不来了。

sentences.en: And even if it does, it's just this kind of sad, low-wattage event that's not carried on TV.
sentences.zh: 即便它真的回来了，也只是那种在电视上都无法播出的、令人唏嘘的低调活动。

sentences.en: I wonder if that's a certain kind of justice, right?
sentences.zh: 我想这算不算是一种某种程度上的天理昭昭呢？

sentences.en: I'm thinking back to the 1940s and this group of foreign journalists that you said wanted as much stature and power and access as they could possibly get, and they got it,
sentences.zh: 我回想起20世纪40年代，你提到过的那群外国记者，他们渴望尽可能多的地位、权力和特权，而他们也确实得到了，

sentences.en: but it doesn't seem like they ever really earned it or adapted their membership or their rules and process to deserve the stature that they got.
sentences.zh: 但感觉他们从来没有真正配得上这些，也没有调整他们的会员结构、规则和流程来配得上他们所获得的地位。

sentences.en: Is it possible that this is exactly the scale of an award show and the influence level that this group should have always had?
sentences.zh: 有没有可能，这才是这个奖项应有的规模，也是这个群体本该一直拥有的影响力水平？

sentences.en: I think it's very possible.
sentences.zh: 我觉得很有可能。

sentences.en: You know, I think people have been asking themselves very difficult questions about who wields power and how do they wield it in this culture.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，我觉得人们一直在反思一些非常艰难的问题，关于在这个文化圈里究竟是谁在掌握权力，他们又是如何行使权力的。

sentences.en: And the Golden Globes and the Hollywood foreign press, even though this is not a very large group, wield incredibly outsized influence because on their way to Oscar, they said,
sentences.zh: 而金球奖和好莱坞外国记者协会，尽管这不是一个很大的群体，却握有极其巨大的超常规影响力，因为在通往奥斯卡的路上，他们会说，

sentences.en: we're narrowing down this field.
sentences.zh: 我们在缩小候选范围。

sentences.en: Sorry if you get excluded.
sentences.zh: 如果你被排除在外，那很遗憾。

sentences.en: And systematically, things were getting excluded and things were getting included that really continued to reinforce outdated power dynamics in our society.
sentences.zh: 通过这种系统性的筛选，一些作品被排除在外，另一些则被纳入其中，这确实进一步巩固了我们社会中过时的权力动态。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: Or at least we should say they used to wield that power.
sentences.zh: 或者至少我们应该说，他们过去曾拥有那种权力。

sentences.en: Used to wield, and we'll see if they get any of it back.
sentences.zh: 曾经拥有，而我们拭目以待他们是否还能夺回一部分。

sentences.en: Certainly, they're going to stop at nothing to try to claw back some of it.
sentences.zh: 当然，他们会不择手段地试图夺回其中的一部分。

sentences.en: You know, once you've tasted that apple, you want a few more bites.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，一旦你尝过了那个禁果的滋味，你就会想再咬几口。

sentences.en: And we've seen the Golden Globes bounce back from scandals in the paSt.
sentences.zh: 我们已经见证过金球奖从过去的丑闻中恢复过来。

sentences.en: They'll try again.
sentences.zh: 他们还会再试一次。

sentences.en: The question now becomes, will Hollywood let them?
sentences.zh: 现在的问题变成了，好莱坞会让他们如愿吗？

sentences.en: And will people still watch and still imbue them with the importance, with the outsized influence that they became so comfortable wielding?
sentences.zh: 人们还会不会继续观看，还会不会赋予他们那种他们曾经习惯于行使的重要性和巨大影响力？

sentences.en: Well, Kyle,
sentences.zh: 好的，凯尔，

sentences.en: thank you very much.
sentences.zh: 非常感谢你。

sentences.en: We appreciate your time.
sentences.zh: 感谢你抽出时间。

sentences.en: Thanks for having me.
sentences.zh: 谢谢邀请我来。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: Here's what else you need to know today.
sentences.zh: 以下是你今天需要了解的其他新闻。

sentences.en: This is a horrific, horrific, painful moment for the city of New York.
sentences.zh: 对于纽约市来说，这是一个极其可怕、极其痛苦的时刻。

sentences.en: On Sunday, at least 19 people, including nine children, were killed in a fire that consumed an apartment building in the Bronx section of New York.
sentences.zh: 周日，纽约布朗克斯区一栋公寓楼发生火灾，造成至少19人死亡，其中包括9名儿童。

sentences.en: City officials called it one of the worst fires in modern times.
sentences.zh: 市政府官员称这是现代史上最严重的火灾之一。

sentences.en: Mayor Eric Adams said the fire was likely caused by a malfunctioning space heater.
sentences.zh: 市长埃里克·亚当斯表示，火灾很可能是由加热器故障引起的。

sentences.en: And, And from that day, you owed me everything you could ever do for me, like I will owe my son if I ever have another.
sentences.zh: 从那一天起，你欠了我你所能为我做的一切，就像如果我有另一个孩子，我也会亏欠我的儿子一样。

sentences.en: But you don't own me.
sentences.zh: 但你并不拥有我。

sentences.en: Sidney Poitier, the Oscar-winning actor whose roles in films like In the Heat of the Night and Guess Who's Coming to Dinner established him as Hollywood's first
sentences.zh: 西德尼·波蒂埃，这位曾凭借《炎热的夜晚》和《猜猜谁来吃晚餐》等影片确立了自己作为好莱坞第一位

sentences.en: Black leading man and who was an outspoken advocate for racial justice has died at the age of 94.
sentences.zh: 黑人男主角地位的奥斯卡影帝、直言不讳的种族正义倡导者，已于94岁高龄逝世。

sentences.en: It's been said that
sentences.zh: 人们常说，

sentences.en: Sidney Poitier does not make movies.
sentences.zh: 西德尼·波蒂埃不拍电影。

sentences.en: He makes milestones.
sentences.zh: 他创造里程碑。

sentences.en: Milestones of artistic excellence.
sentences.zh: 艺术卓越的里程碑。

sentences.en: Milestones of America's progress.
sentences.zh: 美国进步的里程碑。

sentences.en: President Obama awarded Poitier a Presidential Medal of Freedom in a ceremony at the White House.
sentences.zh: 奥巴马总统在白宫举行的仪式上向波蒂埃颁发了总统自由勋章。

sentences.en: Poitier once called his driving purpose to make himself a better person.
sentences.zh: 波蒂埃曾将自己一生的追求称为让自己成为一个更好的人。

sentences.en: He did.
sentences.zh: 他做到了。

sentences.en: And he made us all a little bit better along the way.
sentences.zh: 而且在一路上，他也让我们所有人都变得更好了一点。

sentences.en: Today's episode was produced by
sentences.zh: 今天的节目由

sentences.en: Sidney Harper,
sentences.zh: 西德尼·哈珀、

sentences.en: Michael Simon-Johnson,
sentences.zh: 迈克尔·西蒙-约翰逊、

sentences.en: Stella Tan, and Caitlin Roberts with help from
sentences.zh: 斯特拉·谭和凯特琳·罗伯茨制作

sentences.en: Luke Vanderpluk.
sentences.zh: 卢克·范德普鲁克协助制作。

sentences.en: It was edited by
sentences.zh: 节目由

sentences.en: Liz O'Balen and Larissa Anderson, contains original music by Marion Lozano, and was also engineered by Marion Lozano.
sentences.zh: 莉兹·奥巴伦和拉里萨·安德森剪辑，包含马里恩·洛扎诺的原创音乐，并由马里恩·洛扎诺混音。

sentences.en: Our theme music is by Jim Brunberg and Ben Landsverk of Wonderly.
sentences.zh: 我们的主题音乐由来自Wonderly的吉姆·布伦伯格和本·兰斯韦克创作。

sentences.en: Special thanks to Matt Stevens.
sentences.zh: 特别感谢马特·史蒂文斯。

sentences.en: That's it for The Daily.
sentences.zh: 以上就是本期《每日新闻》的全部内容。

sentences.en: I'm Michael Bavaro.
sentences.zh: 我是迈克尔·巴瓦罗。

sentences.en: See you tomorrow.
sentences.zh: 明天见。

sentences.en: For decades, the Brooklyn Democratic Party operated as a tightly controlled machine.
sentences.zh: 几十年来，布鲁克林民主党一直像一个受到严密控制的机器一样运作。

sentences.en: Until this summer.
sentences.zh: 直到今年夏天。

sentences.en: When elections ushered in a bunch of self-described reformers.
sentences.zh: 当时选举迎来了许多自称改革派的人士。

sentences.en: Ever since, the party has been in the grip of a bruising, chaotic, and sometimes thrilling fight.
sentences.zh: 从那以后，该党一直陷入一场残酷、混乱、有时又令人兴奋的权力斗争中。

sentences.en: In the latest episode of Metro, with me,
sentences.zh: 在最新一期的《都市》节目中，我是

sentences.en: Sarah Koenig, stories of people trying to maintain their influence and losing control along the way.
sentences.zh: 萨拉·科尼格，为您讲述人们试图保持影响力却在过程中失控的故事。

sentences.en: Metro.
sentences.zh: 《都市》。

sentences.en: Listen wherever you get your podcasts.
sentences.zh: 请在各大播客平台收听。
